opponent.label: Beidou
opponent.description: The legendary Uncrowned Lord of the Oceans, founder of the Crux Fleet, captain of the Alcor, and slayer of the sea monster Haishan. Beidou is known for her keen mind, immense strength, and unmatched bravery, becoming a folk hero to the people of Liyue, and a force of good across all of Teyvat.
